question: Tính doanh số bán hàng (tổng số lượng sản phẩm và tổng số tiền thu được) theo từng danh mục sản phẩm.
contexts: ProductCategory(categoryId [PK], categoryName) -- Danh mục sản phẩm
Product(productId [PK], productName, unit, cost, categoryId [FK -> ProductCategory.categoryId], note, productCode) -- Sản phẩm
InvoiceDetail(id [PK], quantity, total, unitPrice, invoiceId [FK -> SaleInvoice.invoiceId], productId [FK -> Product.productId]) -- Chi tiết hóa đơn bán
answer: SELECT pc."categoryName", SUM(id."quantity") AS "totalQuantity", SUM(id."total") AS "totalRevenue" FROM public."ProductCategory" pc JOIN public."Product" p ON pc."categoryId" = p."categoryId" JOIN public."InvoiceDetail" id ON p."productId" = id."productId" GROUP BY pc."categoryName";
ground_truth: SELECT pc."categoryName", SUM(id."quantity") AS "totalQuantity", SUM(id."total") AS "totalRevenue" FROM public."ProductCategory" pc JOIN public."Product" p ON pc."categoryId" = p."categoryId" JOIN public."InvoiceDetail" id ON p."productId" = id."productId" GROUP BY pc."categoryName";

question: Tìm top 5 khách hàng có tổng giá trị mua hàng cao nhất trong năm 2026.
contexts: Customer(customerId [PK], gender, dateOfBirth, note, fullName, phoneNumber, email, wardId [FK -> Ward.wardId], customerGroupId [FK -> CustomerGroup.customerGroupid], customerCode, address, debt) -- Khách hàng

SaleInvoice(invoiceId [PK], invoiceDate, totalAmount, discountAmount, paidAmount, note, employeeId [FK -> Employee.employeeId], customerId [FK -> Customer.customerId], gasBookId [FK -> GasBook.gasBookId], stockId [FK -> Stock.stockId], orderType, invoiceCode, PaymentMethod) -- Hóa đơn bán hàng
answer: SELECT c."customerCode", c."fullName", SUM(si."totalAmount") AS "totalPurchased" FROM public."Customer" c JOIN public."SaleInvoice" si ON c."customerId" = si."customerId" WHERE si."invoiceDate" >= '2026-01-01' AND si."invoiceDate" < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY c."customerCode", c."fullName" ORDER BY "totalPurchased" DESC LIMIT 5;
ground_truth: SELECT c."customerCode", c."fullName", SUM(si."totalAmount") AS "totalPurchased" FROM public."Customer" c JOIN public."SaleInvoice" si ON c."customerId" = si."customerId" WHERE si."invoiceDate" >= '2026-01-01' AND si."invoiceDate" < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY c."customerCode", c."fullName" ORDER BY "totalPurchased" DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Liệt kê chi tiết các sản phẩm đã nhập kho từ nhà cung cấp 'Công ty Gas Tuấn Đạt', gồm mã đơn mua, tên sản phẩm, số lượng và tổng tiền nhập.
contexts: Supplier(supplierId [PK], taxNumber, note, fullName, phoneNumber, email, wardId [FK -> Ward.wardId], createdAt, updatedAt, address, debt) -- Nhà cung cấp

PurchaseOrder(purchaseId [PK], purchaseDate, totalAmount, employeeId [FK -> Employee.employeeId], supplierId [FK -> Supplier.supplierId], note, orderType, stockId [FK -> Stock.stockId], discountAmount, paidAmount, purchaseCode) -- Đơn mua hàng
PurchaseDetail(id [PK], purchaseId [FK -> PurchaseOrder.purchaseId], productId [FK -> Product.productId], quantity, purchasePrice, total) -- Chi tiết đơn mua
Product(productId [PK], productName, unit, cost, categoryId [FK -> ProductCategory.categoryId], note, productCode) -- Sản phẩm
answer: SELECT po."purchaseCode", p."productName", pd."quantity", pd."total" FROM public."Supplier" s JOIN public."PurchaseOrder" po ON s."supplierId" = po."supplierId" JOIN public."PurchaseDetail" pd ON po."purchaseId" = pd."purchaseId" JOIN public."Product" p ON pd."productId" = p."productId" WHERE s."fullName" = 'Công ty Gas Tuấn Đạt';
ground_truth: SELECT po."purchaseCode", p."productName", pd."quantity", pd."total" FROM public."Supplier" s JOIN public."PurchaseOrder" po ON s."supplierId" = po."supplierId" JOIN public."PurchaseDetail" pd ON po."purchaseId" = pd."purchaseId" JOIN public."Product" p ON pd."productId" = p."productId" WHERE s."fullName" = 'Công ty Gas Tuấn Đạt';

question: Cho biết danh sách toàn bộ nhân viên cùng tên chức vụ của họ và tổng số lượng hóa đơn bán hàng mà mỗi nhân viên đã lập.
contexts: Employee(employeeId [PK], employeeCode, positionId [FK -> Position.positionId], note, status, hireDate, createdAt, updatedAt, gender, dateOfBirth, phoneNumber, fullName, email, wardId [FK -> Ward.wardId]) -- Nhân viên
Position(positionId [PK], name) -- Chức vụ

SaleInvoice(invoiceId [PK], invoiceDate, totalAmount, discountAmount, paidAmount, note, employeeId [FK -> Employee.employeeId], customerId [FK -> Customer.customerId], gasBookId [FK -> GasBook.gasBookId], stockId [FK -> Stock.stockId], orderType, invoiceCode, PaymentMethod) -- Hóa đơn bán hàng
answer: SELECT e."employeeCode", e."fullName", pos.name AS "positionName", COUNT(si."invoiceId") AS "invoiceCount" FROM public."Employee" e JOIN public."Position" pos ON e."positionId" = pos."positionId" LEFT JOIN public."SaleInvoice" si ON e."employeeId" = si."employeeId" GROUP BY e."employeeCode", e."fullName", pos.name;
ground_truth: SELECT e."employeeCode", e."fullName", pos.name AS "positionName", COUNT(si."invoiceId") AS "invoiceCount" FROM public."Employee" e JOIN public."Position" pos ON e."positionId" = pos."positionId" LEFT JOIN public."SaleInvoice" si ON e."employeeId" = si."employeeId" GROUP BY e."employeeCode", e."fullName", pos.name;

question: Thống kê tổng doanh thu bán hàng thu được theo từng vùng địa lý (tên khu vực - Area và tên phường/xã - Ward) của khách hàng.
contexts: Area(areaId [PK], areaName) -- Khu vực
Ward(wardId [PK], wardName, areaId [FK -> Area.areaId]) -- Phường xã

Customer(customerId [PK], gender, dateOfBirth, note, fullName, phoneNumber, email, wardId [FK -> Ward.wardId], customerGroupId [FK -> CustomerGroup.customerGroupid], customerCode, address, debt) -- Khách hàng

SaleInvoice(invoiceId [PK], invoiceDate, totalAmount, discountAmount, paidAmount, note, employeeId [FK -> Employee.employeeId], customerId [FK -> Customer.customerId], gasBookId [FK -> GasBook.gasBookId], stockId [FK -> Stock.stockId], orderType, invoiceCode, PaymentMethod) -- Hóa đơn bán hàng
answer: SELECT a."areaName", w."wardName", SUM(si."totalAmount") AS "totalSales" FROM public."Area" a JOIN public."Ward" w ON a."areaId" = w."areaId" JOIN public."Customer" c ON w."wardId" = c."wardId" JOIN public."SaleInvoice" si ON c."customerId" = si."customerId" GROUP BY a."areaName", w."wardName";
ground_truth: SELECT a."areaName", w."wardName", SUM(si."totalAmount") AS "totalSales" FROM public."Area" a JOIN public."Ward" w ON a."areaId" = w."areaId" JOIN public."Customer" c ON w."wardId" = c."wardId" JOIN public."SaleInvoice" si ON c."customerId" = si."customerId" GROUP BY a."areaName", w."wardName";

question: Hiển thị danh sách các sản phẩm đang có số lượng tồn kho dưới 10 tại mỗi kho hàng, bao gồm tên kho, tên sản phẩm và số lượng tồn hiện tại.
contexts: Stock(stockId [PK], name, wardId [FK -> Ward.wardId]) -- Kho hàng
Inventory(inventoryId [PK], stockId [FK -> Stock.stockId], productId [FK -> Product.productId], quantity) -- Tồn kho
Product(productId [PK], productName, unit, cost, categoryId [FK -> ProductCategory.categoryId], note, productCode) -- Sản phẩm
answer: SELECT s.name AS "stockName", p."productName", i.quantity AS "stockQuantity" FROM public."Stock" s JOIN public."Inventory" i ON s."stockId" = i."stockId" JOIN public."Product" p ON i."productId" = p."productId" WHERE i.quantity < 10;
ground_truth: SELECT s.name AS "stockName", p."productName", i.quantity AS "stockQuantity" FROM public."Stock" s JOIN public."Inventory" i ON s."stockId" = i."stockId" JOIN public."Product" p ON i."productId" = p."productId" WHERE i.quantity < 10;

question: Liệt kê các hóa đơn bán hàng có áp dụng giảm giá (discountAmount > 0) cho những khách hàng thuộc nhóm 'Khách VIP'.
contexts: SaleInvoice(invoiceId [PK], invoiceDate, totalAmount, discountAmount, paidAmount, note, employeeId [FK -> Employee.employeeId], customerId [FK -> Customer.customerId], gasBookId [FK -> GasBook.gasBookId], stockId [FK -> Stock.stockId], orderType, invoiceCode, PaymentMethod) -- Hóa đơn bán hàng

Customer(customerId [PK], gender, dateOfBirth, note, fullName, phoneNumber, email, wardId [FK -> Ward.wardId], customerGroupId [FK -> CustomerGroup.customerGroupid], customerCode, address, debt) -- Khách hàng
CustomerGroup(customerGroupid [PK], groupName) -- Nhóm khách hàng
answer: SELECT si."invoiceCode", c."fullName", si."discountAmount" FROM public."SaleInvoice" si JOIN public."Customer" c ON si."customerId" = c."customerId" JOIN public."CustomerGroup" cg ON c."customerGroupId" = cg."customerGroupid" WHERE si."discountAmount" > 0 AND cg."groupName" = 'Khách VIP';
ground_truth: SELECT si."invoiceCode", c."fullName", si."discountAmount" FROM public."SaleInvoice" si JOIN public."Customer" c ON si."customerId" = c."customerId" JOIN public."CustomerGroup" cg ON c."customerGroupId" = cg."customerGroupid" WHERE si."discountAmount" > 0 AND cg."groupName" = 'Khách VIP';

question: Tìm nhân viên đã lập được hóa đơn bán hàng có giá trị cao nhất trong hệ thống, hiển thị mã nhân viên, họ tên, chức vụ và giá trị hóa đơn đó.
contexts: Employee(employeeId [PK], employeeCode, positionId [FK -> Position.positionId], note, status, hireDate, createdAt, updatedAt, gender, dateOfBirth, phoneNumber, fullName, email, wardId [FK -> Ward.wardId]) -- Nhân viên
Position(positionId [PK], name) -- Chức vụ

SaleInvoice(invoiceId [PK], invoiceDate, totalAmount, discountAmount, paidAmount, note, employeeId [FK -> Employee.employeeId], customerId [FK -> Customer.customerId], gasBookId [FK -> GasBook.gasBookId], stockId [FK -> Stock.stockId], orderType, invoiceCode, PaymentMethod) -- Hóa đơn bán hàng
answer: SELECT e."employeeCode", e."fullName", pos.name AS "positionName", si."invoiceCode", si."totalAmount" FROM public."Employee" e JOIN public."Position" pos ON e."positionId" = pos."positionId" JOIN public."SaleInvoice" si ON e."employeeId" = si."employeeId" WHERE si."totalAmount" = (SELECT MAX("totalAmount") FROM public."SaleInvoice");

question: Thống kê tổng số lượng sản phẩm nhập kho và tổng chi phí mua hàng từ mỗi nhà cung cấp, hiển thị tên nhà cung cấp, tổng số lượng và tổng số tiền mua hàng.

PurchaseOrder(purchaseId [PK], purchaseDate, totalAmount, employeeId [FK -> Employee.employeeId], supplierId [FK -> Supplier.supplierId], note, orderType, stockId [FK -> Stock.stockId], discountAmount, paidAmount, purchaseCode) -- Đơn mua hàng
PurchaseDetail(id [PK], purchaseId [FK -> PurchaseOrder.purchaseId], productId [FK -> Product.productId], quantity, purchasePrice, total) -- Chi tiết đơn mua
answer: SELECT s."fullName", SUM(pd.quantity) AS "totalQuantityPurchased", SUM(pd.total) AS "totalCost" FROM public."Supplier" s JOIN public."PurchaseOrder" po ON s."supplierId" = po."supplierId" JOIN public."PurchaseDetail" pd ON po."purchaseId" = pd."purchaseId" GROUP BY s."fullName";
ground_truth: SELECT s."fullName", SUM(pd.quantity) AS "totalQuantityPurchased", SUM(pd.total) AS "totalCost" FROM public."Supplier" s JOIN public."PurchaseOrder" po ON s."supplierId" = po."supplierId" JOIN public."PurchaseDetail" pd ON po."purchaseId" = pd."purchaseId" GROUP BY s."fullName";
